set -euo pipefail

renames=$(git ls-files -z | tr '\0' '\n' | grep -E '(^|/)renames\.conf$' | head -n1)
test -n "$renames"

while IFS= read -r line; do
  case "$line" in
    \#*|"") continue ;;
  esac
  old=${line%%=*}
  new=${line#*=}
  old=$(printf '%s' "$old" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')
  new=$(printf '%s' "$new" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')
  [ -n "$old" ] && [ -n "$new" ] || continue

  old_re=$(printf '%s' "$old" | sed 's/[][\.^$*+?(){}|/]/\\&/g')
  new_repl=$(printf '%s' "$new" | sed 's/[\/&\\]/\\&/g')

  while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
    [ "$file" = "$renames" ] && continue
    case "$file" in
      */renames.conf|renames.conf) continue ;;
    esac
    [ -f "$file" ] || continue
    [ -L "$file" ] && continue
    if grep -IqE "^[[:space:]]*${old_re}[[:space:]]*=" "$file"; then
      sed -i -E "s/^([[:space:]]*)${old_re}([[:space:]]*)=(.*)$/\1${new_repl}\2=\3/" "$file"
    fi
  done < <(git ls-files -z)
done < "$renames"

git add -u
if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
  git -c user.name="Setting Migrator" -c user.email="setting-migrator@example.com" commit -m "Rename old setting keys to current names"
fi
